setup_language_modeling_task: setup a fairseq LanguageModelingTask by loading dictionaries and configuring self, future, or past targets
build_language_modeling_model: build a language model for the LanguageModelingTask and validate that all targets are supported
load_language_modeling_dataset: load a dataset split for language modeling with token blocking and optional sequence shortening
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for language model inference by prepending BOS/EOS tokens and appending pad tokens
run_lm_evaluation_dataloader: run language model evaluation by creating a batch iterator with optional context window support
